fields.description: Save format version. Written as 0x100 by the save initializer and persisted as EEPROM block 0.

fields.description: File 0 stage-name selector: value plus 5 is used as a string-table id for the profile display.
fields.evidence: FUN_080067f8 reads record word0 (DAT_08006b58 + file*0x20 + 0x50) and passes value+5 to FUN_08009188 for profile text (line 5169); persisted via FUN_08006bf8 / FUN_08006c38 / FUN_08006014 / FUN_08006030.
fields.name: file0_stage_name_idx

fields.description: File 0 progress counter: shifted right by 4 it bounds the profile-screen progress-icon draw loop.
fields.evidence: FUN_080067f8 loops while uVar8+0xd < (record word1 >> 4) drawing icons (lines 5266-5285, DAT_08006b58 + file*0x20 + 0x54); fresh default 0x27; persisted via FUN_08006bf8 / FUN_08006c38 / FUN_08006014 / FUN_08006030.
fields.name: file0_progress_count

fields.description: File 0 current stage index: mapped to display text and shown incremented by one.
fields.evidence: FUN_080067f8 passes record word3 (DAT_08006b58 + file*0x20 + 0x5c) to FUN_08009644 and formats word3+1 into profile text (lines 5134, 5162-5170); synced with game state +0x114 by FUN_08006bf8 and saved by FUN_08006c38 / FUN_08006030; fresh default 1.
fields.name: file0_stage_index

fields.description: File 0 completion count: bounds the profile-screen completion-icon draw loop.
fields.evidence: FUN_080067f8 loops while uVar10 < record word4 (DAT_08006b58 + file*0x20 + 0x60, lines 5283-5290); fresh default 3; persisted via FUN_08006bf8 / FUN_08006c38 / FUN_08006014 / FUN_08006030.
fields.name: file0_completion_count

fields.description: File 0 per-icon status nibbles: four 2-bit groups each rendered as one profile-screen icon.
fields.evidence: FUN_080067f8 extracts (word5 >> (2*i)) & 3 for i in 0..3 and draws one icon per group (lines 5248-5261, DAT_08006b58 + file*0x20 + 0x64); persisted via FUN_08006bf8 / FUN_08006c38 / FUN_08006014 / FUN_08006030.
fields.name: file0_icon_status

fields.description: File 0 detail flag: nonzero unlocks the detailed profile display branch.
fields.evidence: FUN_080067f8 gates the detail display on record word6 != 0 (DAT_08006b58 + file*0x20 + 0x68, lines 5242 and 5185-5186); persisted via FUN_08006bf8 / FUN_08006c38 / FUN_08006014 / FUN_08006030.
fields.name: file0_active_flag

fields.description: File 0 extra word: round-trips between the save record and game state but no display or gameplay reader was identified; gameplay role undetermined.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006bf8 copies record word7 to game state and FUN_08006c38 writes it back (rec[7] <-> struct-0x30); block I/O via FUN_08006014 / FUN_08006030; never consumed elsewhere in decomp.
